transcript.answer: No, not any more. ADR-039 originally decided that the org-default review agent should be pinned to a different model family from the implementer. That was backed by a settings-UI warning and the model-family helpers from PR #1091. The ADR's 2026-10-14 amendment reversed this. `code-review` and `code-review-recheck` now run on `gemini-4-argon`, the same family as the implementation loop's `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`. The amendment says cross-family review "is no longer a rule, only one input to the model choice." The reason given was a local bench where Argon caught more known must-fixes than Sonnet. The cost is that Argon is slower and about 40% dearer. `code-review-reply` stays on `claude-sonnet-4-6`.

judgements.reason: The answer gets the amendment right, but it says ADR-039 'originally decided' cross-family review and that this is 'not any more' the rule, while the gold says the ADR is still a draft and cross-family review was never a rule.
